description: The figure presents three side-by-side horizontal bar charts titled “Understanding,” “Reasoning,” and “Trustworthiness,” illustrating the average performance of multiple language models across these three evaluation categories. In each panel, the category axis is vertical and lists the same set of model names in a consistent top-to-bottom order: gpt-4o-2024-11-20, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, internlm3-8b-instruct, glm-4-9b-chat-1m, gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, ProLong-512k-Instruct, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, Phi-3.5-mini-instruct, Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, and Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407; the bars alternate between two blue hues (a darker royal blue and a lighter teal-blue) without an explicit legend. The value axis is horizontal in all panels and uses percentage tick labels on a linear scale; “Understanding” spans 0% to 100% with 20% tick intervals, “Reasoning” spans 0% to 70% with 10% tick intervals, and “Trustworthiness” spans 0% to 100% with 20% tick intervals, with numeric values annotated at the end of each bar. In the Understanding panel, annotated values include 98.0 (gpt-4o-2024-11-20), 91.7 (Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M), 87.1 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M), 71.2 (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18), 68.6 (internlm3-8b-instruct), 55.6 (glm-4-9b-chat-1m), 53.3 (gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14), 50.5 (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), 45.8 (ProLong-512k-Instruct), 33.6 (Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct), 32.2 (Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct), 25.3 (Phi-3.5-mini-instruct), 16.9 (Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct), 15.4 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), 13.2 (Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct), 9.8 (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct), 3.1 (Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct), and 2.4 (Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407). In the Reasoning panel, the annotated bar values are 66.5, 58.0, 34.9, 39.6, 28.6, 34.3, 32.5, 16.8, 31.7, 32.0, 17.6, 28.4, 6.8, 13.0, 17.2, 12.9, 19.8, and 7.2 respectively for the same model order.
